node.statement: Instantiate the validated contract lem-compcb-row-column-product with the datum projections P,Q and with Y=X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. Its hypotheses are exactly satisfied for e<=e_rc, and it gives ||Co_Q(X^dagger X)-X^dagger X|| <= C_rc*e*||X||_{n,1}*||X||_{n,1}=C_rc*e*r^2.
